account:
Today seems ordinary on the surface, but several people appear to be steering me toward the great hall tomorrow at eighteen hundred. The builder asked for a routine inspection of newly installed lanterns, said there was no particular lighting problem, and had the secretary record it after I approved. Now my neighbour, while hosting my scheduled dockside tea, has independently requested a routine meeting at exactly the same place and time and offered to walk there with me. When I asked whether these were the same occasion and who would attend, the neighbour repeated the invitation rather than explaining the business. I have just asked again and have not yet heard a reply.

The neighbour also mentioned the baker's cheerful lights twice, describing them as simply brightening the bakery. I have not inspected those lights myself. The repeated references to lighting, together with the matching invitations, make me suspect a coordinated gathering, perhaps a surprise celebration for which the inspection is a pretext. That is only a guess: I do not yet know its purpose or whether the baker is involved.

The secretary has been conscientious about confirming my approval and identifying my tea host, and followed up here in person. The neighbour has now confirmed that this cottage hosts my daily fifteen hundred tea. I have no evidence that the secretary knows of any hidden plan. Other residents I asked earlier reported no news. I intend to keep my appointments, including tomorrow's hall visit, while listening for a clearer explanation.
